name: Baikonur Site 200
best_known_for: Proton-M heavy-lift pad — Mir modules, ISS Zvezda/Zarya, GLONASS, Luna 25
credit: Fleet launch-site entry added during the cross-correlation analysis (#306 follow-up). Site 200 hosts pads PU1 (LC200/39) and PU2 (LC200/40) for Proton-K and Proton-M. Distinct from Sites 1/5 (R-7/Soyuz) and 31/6 (R-7/Soyuz).
